Class products_controller.Product

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.project2.csce331.products_controller.Product
Enclosing class:
products_controller
public static class products_controller.Product extends Object
Immutable table model for products displayed in products_controller.products_table.

Note: Quantity here represents the display quantity/popularity used in the UI. Persistence of quantity depends on the backing schema; the Item entity used for writes does not include quantity.
